title: Hypergraph Universality and Erdos-Posa Failure for Chromatically Rich Odd Cycles
summary: For every fixed $k\ge 3$, every finite nonempty clutter $\mathcal{H}$ can be realized exactly as the family of inclusion-minimal terminal traces of the $k$-bad odd cycles, namely the odd cycles $C$ satisfying $χ(G[V(C)])\ge k+1$. The host graph $G$ may be chosen $2$-connected, with $T=V(\mathcal{H})$ independent, and with $χ(G)=k+1$, $ω(G)=k$, and $|E(G)|\le k|V(G)|$. Given any integer $B\ge 1$, one realization simultaneously preserves the transversal number, the fractional packing number, and every integer $c$-packing number for $1\le c\le B$.
